newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Ongoing bull run sends Bucharest share prices up.
newsitem.headline: Ongoing bull run sends Bucharest share prices up.

text.p: A four-week-old winning streak continued on the Bucharest stock exchange on Tuesday helping most prices to consolidate previous advances and pushing two independent indices to year highs.
Volumes more than doubled to 57,452 shares and turnover rose some 216 million lei to 477.8 million amid strong foreign and institutional investor interest, traders said.
"We haven't had turnover levels comparable with today's figure since last April," said a trader.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker -- which made the top tier on Tuesday -- led the pack, taking 78 percent of turnover and closing 2,000 lei higher at 22,700.
But brokers said the big volume had nothing to do with its promotion to the high board.

"Azomures was following an upward path anyway," a broker said, adding that the bulk of Azomures volumes came from cross trades -- deals allowing a broker to act for both the buyer and the seller of a security in the same deal.

Azomures -- which investors and brokers perceive as the exchange's most attractive and liquid company -- is the only stock trading on the first tier. All the other 16 trade on the second tier, where qualifying criteria are less tough.
Twelve stocks climbed and three fell. Syringe maker Sanevit SA and Foraj Sonde SA were suspended pending an announcement and respectively a share split.
Traders expected the bull run to keep on in the next few sessions but only for the more liquid stocks. "The others are bound to experience a correction," said one.

Investors on Tuesday also focused on Carbid Fox, Romania's sole carbide producer, and engineer Artrom, which had 33.5 million and 26.5 million lei in turnover -- which until recently equalled total turnover per session.
Two unofficial indices - the VAB and the BIG -- rose by 6.0 and respectively 6.3 percent from the previous session.
